profile: Federal installations and secure facilities builder. Everything it does is behind a fence; almost nothing it does is behind an airlock, and it has never noticed the difference matters here.

projects.title: Installation Entry Control Facility
projects.narrative: Entry control facility with force protection standoff, a visitor centre and a vehicle inspection canopy at a garrison gate.

projects.title: Naval Operations Support Complex
projects.narrative: Operations support complex at a naval base, with a secure compound, a watch floor and administrative wings.

projects.title: Munitions Storage Modernisation
projects.narrative: Munitions storage modernisation across an airfield, with earth-covered magazines and a new inspection facility.

projects.title: Federal Data Centre
projects.narrative: Federal data centre with concurrent maintainability, a diverse power feed and a hardened envelope.

projects.title: Barracks Renewal Programme
projects.narrative: Barracks renewal across four buildings on an active garrison, phased around unit rotations.

projects.title: Veterinary and Working Dog Facility
projects.narrative: Veterinary treatment and working dog kennel facility with isolation runs and a surgical suite.

projects.title: Regional Emergency Operations Centre
projects.narrative: Hardened emergency operations centre with a dispatch floor and continuity suites.

projects.title: Port Security Upgrade
projects.narrative: Security screening and access control upgrades at a working port.

projects.title: Troop Medical Clinic
projects.narrative: Troop medical clinic with treatment rooms and a pharmacy, built inside an existing fence line.

projects.title: Restricted Secure Facility
projects.narrative: Secure facility delivered under a facility clearance; the mission, the location and the client cannot be described to a third party.
